description: This file defines the InterestRateChartSlabComparator class, which implements comparison logic for interest rate chart slabs based on amount and period ranges, used for sorting interest rate chart slabs within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabComparator
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting interest rate chart slabs based on amount and period ranges.

methods.name: InterestRateChartSlabComparator
methods.description: Constructor that sets the primary grouping criterion (by amount or period).

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two interest rate chart slab objects based on configured sorting logic.

methods.name: comparePeriods
methods.description: Compares two slabs based on their starting periods.

methods.name: compareAmounts
methods.description: Compares two slabs based on their amount range starting values.
